[[Kaolin Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Ranger's Construct]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sunjiang District]] (and the corresponding [[Sunjiang District (explorable area)|explorable area]]).

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:Lengthens [[Dazed]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ivory Bow]] [[dye]]d silver.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Longbow (wooden)|Longbow]] from crafters [[Mathilde]] or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Silencing]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]


Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas affect core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
